+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import ts from 'typescript'
+const source = readFileSync(new URL('../src/model.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
+const compiled = ts.transpileModule(source, { compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022 } }).outputText

+
+test('CSV preserves filters, encodes literal search and excludes pagination', () => {
+  const url = new URL(exportUrl({ q: '张 %_ &', status: 'revoked', course_id: 'course', sort_by: 'learner_name', sort_order: 'asc', page: 3, page_size: 20 }), 'http://127.0.0.1')
+  assert.equal(url.pathname, '/api/certificates/export.csv')
+  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('q'), '张 %_ &')
+  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('status'), 'revoked')
+  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('sort_by'), 'learner_name')
+  assert.equal(url.searchParams.has('page'), false)
+  assert.equal(url.searchParams.has('page_size'), false)
+  assert.equal(new URL(exportUrl({ q: '', course_id: undefined }), 'http://127.0.0.1').search, '')
+})
+test('pending issuance keys are isolated by tenant, administrator and course', () => {
+  const user = { admin: { id: 'a' }, tenant: { id: 't' } }
+  const key = batchStorageKey(user, 'c')
+  assert.notEqual(key, batchStorageKey({ ...user, admin: { id: 'b' } }, 'c'))
+  assert.notEqual(key, batchStorageKey({ ...user, tenant: { id: 'u' } }, 'c'))
+  assert.notEqual(key, batchStorageKey(user, 'd'))
+  assert.equal(key, batchStorageKey(user, 'c'))
+})
+test('tenant date formatting observes Sydney DST and Perth zone', () => {
+  assert.match(formatDate('2026-10-20T23:30:00Z', 'Australia/Sydney'), /21 Oct 2026.*10:30/)
+  assert.match(formatDate('2026-10-20T23:30:00Z', 'Australia/Perth'), /21 Oct 2026.*07:30/)
+  assert.match(formatDate('2026-06-20T23:30:00Z', 'Australia/Sydney'), /21 June 2026.*09:30/)
+})
+test('HTTP status governs success, not the presence of a data envelope', async () => {
+  await assert.rejects(checked(Promise.resolve({ data: { ok: true }, error: { error: { code: 'course_not_finished', message: 'Not finished' } }, response: new Response('', { status: 409 }) })), error => error.status === 409 && error.message === 'Not finished')
+  assert.deepEqual(await checked(Promise.resolve({ data: { failed_count: 1 }, response: new Response() })), { failed_count: 1 })
+})

+  await assert.rejects(checked(Promise.reject(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))), error => error.status === 0 && uncertain(error))
+  await assert.rejects(checked(Promise.resolve({ response: new Response() })), error => error.status === 500 && uncertain(error))
+  assert.equal(uncertain(new RequestError('busy', 503)), true)
+  assert.equal(uncertain(new RequestError('conflict', 409)), false)
+  assert.equal(uncertain(new RequestError('expired', 401)), false)
+})

// Run against an explicitly enabled development mock server.
// PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE optionally points to an existing Playwright index.mjs (no dependency installation needed).
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { mkdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import path from 'node:path'
const { chromium } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE ? pathToFileURL(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE).href : 'playwright')
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, ...(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE ? { executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE } : {}) })
const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, acceptDownloads: true })
const page = await context.newPage()
const runtimeErrors = []
page.on('pageerror', error => runtimeErrors.push(error.message))
page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'warning' || (message.type() === 'error' && !message.text().includes('Failed to load resource:') && !message.text().includes('net::ERR_'))) runtimeErrors.push(message.text()) })
const requests = []
page.on('request', request => { if (request.url().includes('/api/')) requests.push({ url: request.url(), method: request.method(), key: request.headers()['idempotency-key'] }) })
const visible = text => page.getByText(text, { exact: false }).first().waitFor()
const search = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Search learner or certificate' })
async function login(username = 'sydney.admin') {
  await page.getByLabel('Username', { exact: true }).fill(username)
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill('DemoPass123!')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click()
  await visible(username === 'sydney.admin' ? 'Sydney Training' : 'Perth Training')
  await page.locator('.table-footer').waitFor()
}
async function scenario(value) { await page.locator('#scenario').selectOption(value) }
async function selectCourse(title) {
  await page.locator('#issue-course').click()
  await page.getByRole('option', { name: title, exact: true }).click()
}
async function openBatch() {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Issue certificates', exact: true }).first().click()
  await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Issue certificates' }).waitFor()
}
async function closeBatch() { await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Issue certificates' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close this dialog' }).click() }
async function shot(name) {
  if (!process.env.SCREENSHOT_DIR) return
  await mkdir(process.env.SCREENSHOT_DIR, { recursive: true })
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(process.env.SCREENSHOT_DIR, `${name}.png`), fullPage: false })
}
try {
  await page.goto(process.env.FRONTEND_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/')
  assert.match(await page.title(), /Certificate Admin/)
  await visible('Development mock mode')
  await page.getByLabel('Username', { exact: true }).fill('sydney.admin')
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill('wrong')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).click()
  await visible('Invalid username or password.')
  await login()
  await page.reload(); await visible('Total 27 certificates')
  console.log('PASS login, invalid credentials, cookie identity restoration, nonblank page')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go to page 2', exact: true }).click()
  await page.waitForResponse(response => response.url().includes('/api/certificates?') && new URL(response.url()).searchParams.get('page') === '2')
  await search.fill('Alex')
  await visible('Total 1 certificates'); assert.equal(await page.locator('.el-pager .is-active').innerText(), '1')
  await page.getByRole('columnheader', { name: 'Learner' }).click()
  await visible('Total 1 certificates')
  await page.getByLabel('Filter by status').click(); await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Revoked', exact: true }).click()
  await visible('No matching certificates')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filters', exact: true }).first().click(); await visible('Total 27 certificates')
  console.log('PASS search, sorting, filtering, pagination reset, no-match empty state')
  await scenario('error'); await visible('Certificates could not be loaded')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry', exact: true }).click(); await visible('Certificates could not be loaded')
  await scenario('empty'); await visible('No certificates yet'); await shot('empty')
  await scenario('normal'); await visible('Total 27 certificates')
  await search.fill('Alex'); await visible('Total 1 certificates')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'View certificate for Alex Chen' }).click()
  const drawer = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Certificate details' })
  await drawer.getByText('21 Oct 2026, 10:30', { exact: true }).waitFor()
  await drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke certificate', exact: true }).click()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keep certificate' }).click()
  assert.equal(await drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke certificate', exact: true }).count(), 1)
  await drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke certificate', exact: true }).click()
  await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Revoke certificate' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke certificate', exact: true }).click()
  await drawer.getByText('This certificate has been revoked', { exact: false }).waitFor()
  await shot('detail')
  await drawer.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close this dialog' }).click()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filters', exact: true }).first().click(); await visible('Total 27 certificates')
  console.log('PASS list error/retry, tenant empty, detail tenant timezone, revoke cancel/confirm')
  const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export CSV' }).click()
  const download = await downloadPromise
  const text = await readFile(await download.path(), 'utf8')
  assert.equal(text.split('\r\n').length, 28)
  const exportRequest = requests.filter(item => item.url.includes('export.csv')).at(-1)
  assert.equal(new URL(exportRequest.url).searchParams.has('page'), false)
  console.log('PASS direct CSV download includes all 27 records beyond current page')
  await scenario('partial'); await page.locator('.table-footer').waitFor()

# Frontend console

Vue 3 + TypeScript + Element Plus. All business requests go through the existing cookie-authenticated typed client and shared DTOs. No backend or shared contract files are changed.

## Run

From the repository root, after `npm ci`:

```powershell
npm run dev:frontend
```

Default is real API mode, proxied from `http://127.0.0.1:5173/api` to `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Start the backend separately for integration. A 501 response is displayed as an error; there is no fallback to fake data.

For isolated development only:

```powershell
$env:VITE_API_MODE = 'mock'
npm run dev:frontend
```

The mock banner and scenario selector are always visible in this mode. Accounts: `sydney.admin` / `perth.admin`, password `DemoPass123!`. Mock state lives only in the Vite process and resets on restart. The scenario selector demonstrates empty/list error, partial batch failure, lost response, 503, 409 and 401. Loading is visible on every mock request. There are 27 initial Sydney records and four Perth records, a future course and an empty course. Mock CSV downloads use the same development middleware. No mock module is shipped in the browser production bundle; Vite preview does not serve mock endpoints.

To return to real mode, stop Vite, run `Remove-Item Env:VITE_API_MODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`, then restart. Session cookies from the mock are not real backend sessions; sign in again.

## Checks

```powershell
npm run test --workspace @certificate-admin/frontend
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm run contract:check
```

The unit suite uses the existing TypeScript compiler and Node test runner. It checks CSV parameters, identity-scoped pending keys, tenant timezones and DST, HTTP status handling and uncertain outcomes.

Browser regression tests require a running explicit mock server and an existing Playwright installation (no new dependencies or root lockfile changes):

```powershell
# Optional when Playwright is supplied by an external tool runtime:
$env:PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE = 'C:/path/to/playwright/index.mjs'
$env:PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE = 'C:/path/to/chrome.exe'
# Optional evidence directory outside the repository:
$env:SCREENSHOT_DIR = 'C:/path/to/evidence'
npm run test:e2e --workspace @certificate-admin/frontend
```

The browser suite explicitly resets only development mock memory using `POST /__dev/reset`; this route exists exclusively when mock mode is enabled. It never calls a real-backend reset endpoint. It tests login/restoration, searches, filters, pagination/sort, stale responses, loading/empty/errors, details, revoke cancel/confirm, all-matching CSV, partial results, pending-key reload/retry, 503/409, account switching, 401 cleanup, desktop/mobile overflow and runtime errors. It intentionally generates HTTP errors and a lost connection in development scenarios.

## Behavior and integration notes

- Issuance is synchronous, with an indeterminate indicator. Counts and results come from the completed response; partial failures are never called full success.
- Pending UUIDs are saved before submission in sessionStorage, scoped by administrator, tenant and course. Unknown outcomes and errors retain the original key. Selecting that course again, including after a reload, exposes the original-key retry. Completed batches clear the key; only the explicit “Start a new batch” action begins another operation from the results view. Session storage must be enabled.
- Authentication/session changes clear private UI state and invalidate previous requests. Pending keys remain isolated so the original administrator can recover a result later.
- The installed openapi-fetch helper omits null-only properties in its inferred response type. Issued/failed variants are checked for their required nulls at runtime and reconstructed as shared DTOs without assertions or new wire interfaces.
- Dates use the authenticated tenant IANA timezone via Intl. CSV is a same-origin browser download with filters/sort and no page parameters. The frontend reports only that the download was requested; browser/server errors during a download must be checked in the browser downloads panel.
- Mock testing does not verify real backend authentication, authorization, transactions, concurrency, CSV escaping/streaming or database correctness. These require backend integration.
- Element Plus retains the scaffold's full registration/CSS import. The production build passes with a nonblocking large-chunk warning; tree-shaken registration is a future optimization.
- Section 8 independent reflection/design answers are untouched.
